title: daniellia ogea
intro: Daniellia ogea, commonly known as Afzelia ogea, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of West Africa. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities that provide relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Daniellia ogea include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Daniellia ogea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial and antimalarial properties.
